agentModelMap._comment: LIVE agent model assignments — must stay in sync with openclaw.json agents.list[].model. This is the source of truth for smart-router skill capability filtering.
agentModelMap._howToChange: 1) Edit openclaw.json agents.list[].model.primary/fallbacks  2) Run: openclaw doctor  3) Restart gateway  4) Update _updated above
agentModelMap._policy: 9Router is the central proxy — add/swap subscriptions in 9Router UI to change routing without touching code. Ollama (free/local) for OPS+HATAKE. PAYG (zai) is last-resort only. NEVER hardcode model in cron payloads — crons inherit agent model config automatically.

main.reason: CEO orchestrator: always-on-premium = best available subscription. Codex for direct fallback. zai last resort.

allrounder.reason: COO/CSO conversations: same tier as main.

eng.reason: Best coding tools: coding-factory routes to Cursor/Kiro/Claude Code. Opus fallback for hard architecture problems.

research.reason: Deep analysis: Claude Opus 4.6 is strongest reasoning model. coding-factory as cost-equivalent backup.

finance.reason: Financial analysis: reliable mid-tier. Codex for portfolio/strategy when needed.

ops.reason: Monitoring: free local model (58s cold start). Heartbeat-cheap fallback keeps ops running even if Ollama is cold.

infosec.reason: Security analysis: reliable responses required. Codex fallback for deep security reviews.

hatake.reason: Intent parsing: qwen2.5-coder:7b best for JSON/intent extraction. Free providers as fallback.

howToSwitch._instructions: To change a model for any agent:
steps: 1. Edit /Users/redinside/.openclaw/openclaw.json → agents.list[] → find agent by id → update model.primary and model.fallbacks
4. Update agentModelMap._updated above to keep this registry in sync
howToSwitch.routingDesign: 9Router is the central proxy. To add a new provider (e.g. a new Claude account): add it in 9Router UI at http://localhost:20128 → Providers. It immediately becomes available via combo routes (always-on-premium, coding-factory, etc.) — no code change needed.
howToSwitch.example: To give ENG access to a new Kiro account: add it in 9Router UI. The coding-factory route automatically picks it up.

providerConfig._instructions: Add your API keys here. Subscription providers don't need keys (handled by 9Router).

anthropic.note: Claude Code account registered in 9Router. Routes via cc/ prefix. Re-auth at http://localhost:20128 → Providers if token expires.

openai-codex.note: Configured in openclaw.json agent model sections.

perplexity.note: Pro plan ($20/mo) includes sonar, sonar-pro, sonar-reasoning.

moonshot.note: Pay-as-you-go. Only used for long-context tasks.

zai.note: Pay-as-you-go via z.ai (international endpoint). Models: glm-4.7 (standard). WARNING: glm-4.7-flashx does NOT exist — causes hard failures.

ollama.note: Local. Free. Must have Ollama running with models pulled. Currently: llama3.1:8b (OPS), qwen2.5-coder:7b (HATAKE).

9router.note: 9Router local proxy — central routing hub. Add subscriptions via UI, they become available to ALL agents via combo routes.

comboRoutes.always-on-premium: Best available subscription (Codex, Kiro, Claude Code, iFlow)
comboRoutes.coding-factory: Best available coding subscription (Cursor, Kiro, Claude Code)
